```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
root <- if (dir.exists("artifacts")) "." else ".."
source(file.path(root, "manuscript", "R", "build_stats_catalog.R"))
source(file.path(root, "manuscript", "R", "inline_stats.R"))
if (isTRUE(params$dev_mode)) Sys.setenv(MANUSCRIPT_DEV_MODE = "1") else
  Sys.unsetenv("MANUSCRIPT_DEV_MODE")
K <- mw_init_stats(root)

# Word counts are MEASURED, not remembered. The journal asks for two counts,
# and a title page that states a count the manuscript no longer has is the same
# class of defect this whole apparatus exists to prevent -- a number typed once
# and outliving its source. Both are counted from the .qmd at render time.
wc <- mw_wordcount(file.path(root, "manuscript", "midwife_persistence.qmd"))
```

Kept as its own file from the blinded manuscript body, the arrangement carried
over from the earlier Obstetrics & Gynecology draft. Midwifery (Elsevier) does
not use a title-page Précis; instead it requires Highlights -- 3-5 bullet
points, each <=85 characters -- uploaded as a SEPARATE document at submission.
See manuscript/highlights.qmd, built from the same statistics catalog so it
cannot drift from the numbers reported here or in the abstract.
-->
